tools.name: search_products
tools.description: List the store's docking stations with price in US cents and specs. A spec the store has not filled in is null and is named in missing_specs.

query.description: What the shopper is looking for, in plain language.

max_price_cents.description: Highest price to include, in US cents.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check one docking station against the shopper's laptop and displays. Returns compatible, incompatible or unknown, with one line per check and the specs the store is missing.

laptop_port.description: The laptop port the dock plugs into.

displays_at_4k60.description: How many external displays must run at 4K 60 Hz at the same time.

min_power_delivery_w.description: Watts the laptop needs from the dock, if it charges through it.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Quote a demo order for one product at the current price. Places nothing. Show the quote to the visitor and ask them to confirm before confirm_demo_order.

tools.name: confirm_demo_order
tools.description: Place the simulated order for a quote, only after the visitor has seen the quote and confirmed it. Nothing is charged or shipped.

confirmed_by_visitor.description: True only when the visitor confirmed this quote in the conversation.
